units.source_text: 老河童用那双炯炯有神的眼睛凝视了我一会儿。

en.t: The old kappa gazed at me for a while with those bright, piercing eyes.

units.source_text: 他这才站起了身，走到屋角，从顶棚拽了拽一根耷拉下来绳子。

en.t: Only then did he stand up, walk to the corner of the room, and tug on a rope hanging down from the ceiling.

units.source_text: 于是，我刚才没发现的一扇天窗打开了。

en.t: Then a skylight I had not noticed before opened.

units.source_text: 那扇圆天窗上方，万里晴空，松柏伸展着桠杈。

en.t: Above the round skylight stretched a boundless clear sky, with pines and cypresses spreading out their branches.

units.source_text: 还能看见那好似巨大的箭头一般高耸的枪岳峰。

en.t: I could also see the peak of Mount Yari towering like an enormous arrowhead.

units.source_text: 我就像是看到飞机的孩子一样，开心得跳起来了。

en.t: Like a child who had seen an airplane, I jumped up in delight.
